name: Ferrofluid-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Several bright contour shapes cross the frame at once, showing the fluid's form better than the sparser frames.

tagline: Glowing contour lines drift like magnetic fluid across a black field.
summary: A dark canvas filled with thin luminous cyan and violet wisps that curl and merge like liquid metal seen through edge light. Moving the pointer dims the glow in a soft halo around it.
appearance: A black rectangle scattered with thin, bright cyan contour lines, some curling into loops and spikes, with occasional lilac streaks. Most of the surface is empty darkness; the marks are small, crisp and high contrast.
behaviour: The lines flow steadily in one direction, bending and joining as they go, so the pattern never repeats. The pointer creates a soft circular dimple where the glow fades out around the cursor.
search_phrases: glowing lines flowing in the dark
neon contour waves for a hero
use_when: A dark hero or full-page backdrop needs slow, organic light with no text in the way.
avoid_when: Light themes or low-power devices: the glow relies on black, and the shader renders every frame.
customise: The colour set, flow direction, speed, scale, turbulence, rim sharpness, glow and pointer strength are props. The shader's shape logic needs a source edit.
weight_why: A full-screen fragment shader renders every animation frame for the whole session.

a11y.note: Decorative only, with no reduced-motion check, so the shader keeps running for users who ask for less motion.

issues: Most of the frame stays empty black, so the effect reads faintly at small sizes.
polish_why: Distinctive, clean shader look; thin lines and lots of dead black space.
